messages:
Alex K: Quick update from the Peregrine Networks POC runs — did a 30m throughput sweep this morning, results attached below. Observed consistent avg latency but 99.9p spikes during burst windows.
Hema R: Can you paste the exact load command and model config you used? want to reproduce locally.
Alex K: Running against redwood-v2-large (quantized), 8 GPUs in Dedicated pool. Load command: ```vegeta attack -rate=1200 -duration=30m -connections=600 | vegeta report -type=json``` Also used a 3m warmup and prefix caching enabled on the runtime.
Jordan M: 1200 rps sustained is our target, right? what was concurrency per worker and batching settings?
Alex K: concurrency ~16 per process, batch target 64 tokens, max_batch_latency=15ms. Observed healthy throughput until bursts where KV-cache miss rate jumped ~18%.
Priya S: That KV miss jump correlates with their input distribution — lots of new sessions in the morning spike. They can’t afford >300ms 99p. what was your 99p and 99.9p numbers?
Alex K: 99p ~180ms, 99.9p ~520ms during the highest burst window. Baseline (no burst) 99.9p ~210ms.
Jordan M: 520ms is a red flag for them. Any idea whether pre-warming more GPU processes helps?
Alex K: Quick experiment: spun up +50% workers and saw 99.9p drop to ~320ms but cost increased ~45% for the window. Suggests capacity is the main limiter; batching helps but only when cache hit rate is high.
Hema R: Can we try two mitigations in next run: 1) aggressive pre-warm (autoscale min nodes +50%) 2) enable per-customer request hedging with fallback to thin variant (redwood-v2-small) after 250ms?
Alex K: Yup — scheduling a run for 10:00 PT with both. Also adding a run where we pin model to lower-latency quant config.
Priya S: From presales pov we need clear cost delta slide: baseline vs pre-warm vs hedging. Also need to call out security blocker: Peregrine asks for IP allowlist and cross-region failover — will that break autoscaling fallbacks?
Jordan M: IP allowlist shouldn't break routing but it complicates immediate cross-region fallback if their infra prevents outgoing egress. Need to confirm VPC egress / peering behavior.
Alex K: Noted. I'll confirm with eng-ops.
perf-bot: Test run scheduled: run_id=rn-peregrine-20260318-10; results will post to the thread when complete.
Hema R: One more ask from sales/legal: provide short note on expected token-unit burn for 1k QPS over 30 days at average 120 tokens/resp — they want a ballpark cost impact for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Alex K: Ballpark: 1k QPS * 120 tokens * 86,400s/day ~ 10.37B tokens/day. We'll convert to pricing once we pick hosted per-token unit. I’ll add a slide.
Priya S: Action items: Alex -> run the two mitigations and attach raw vegeta JSON; Jordan -> compute pre-warm cost delta and impact on committed capacity; Hema -> prepare the short cost note and sample SSO/IP allowlist language for the security questionnaire.
Alex K: Sounds good. Will post results and quick summary with charts in this thread. :thumbsup:
Hema R: Thanks — if 99.9p stays >400ms after mitigation we should offer canary with hedging as an enterprise add-on during the trial.
Alex K: Agreed. Scheduling run now.
